task.instruction: I've been sending a bunch of money via Zelle each month. Can you figure out who's getting it (use HooliChat DMs and HooliMail Zelle confirmations to put names to recipients), and then cross-check against my SpeedTax return for charitable donations or dependents claimed there? If SpeedTax only shows aggregate totals (not per-recipient names), call that out as inconclusive instead of guessing. I don't want to double-dip by accident.
